stories.title: Binance releases proof of reserves data for ten cryptocurrencies; oil tumbles amid hopes of Iran war breakthrough – as it happened
summary: Look at some fraudulent exchanges that absconded, P2P platforms, and commercial banks: their ledgers are opaque; once the website is shut down, they simply abscond with the funds, the company is liquidated or goes bankrupt, and all they need to do is give you an arbitrary excuse.
As for how much money was actually in the account and where it went, there is no way to know.These kinds of closures happen without any warning—they just disappear.
There is no real operation, no one comes out to explain what happened, and it is even less possible for withdrawals to be opened.

stories.title: Affordability top of mind for voters in final sprint to midterms: ‘I have to pick between medicine or groceries’
summary: Cost of living has loomed over this election cycle as workers and unions champion candidates fighting for higher wages and tackling rising pricesFor millions of Americans heading to the polls on Tuesday, affordability is a constant and worsening issue, and it’s been a prevailing concern this election cycle.In Lorain county, Ohio, Gina Jones and her co-workers at the Lorain county job and family services have been on strike since February 2026, the longest public sector strike in Ohio history and on pace to break the US record for longest public sector strike.
